text:
marta: Heads-up — Windridge dedicated slice upgrade proposed for Sat 23:30-01:00 UTC. Need quick sync: image pin, canary plan, quiet window lock, and rollback gates. Who can review?

kevin: I'm available. Suggest pin runtime to runtime:v2.4.0-hotfix2 (contains kv-cache GC fix). Will push tag after CI passes.

ops_bot: Note: autoscaler will be suspended during maintenance window unless override flag set.

sylvia: QA: ran end-to-end tests on v2.4.0-hotfix2 in staging. Found a sporadic 502 on long-context tests (~0.4% in 2k requests). Investigating. Not a blocker if canary monitors it.

marta: Thanks. Can we set canary to 5% for 20m, then 25% for 15m, then 100% if green? Need rollback thresholds: 0.8% error or p95 latency +600ms. Also request drain grace of 60s.

kevin: Fine. I'll prepare rollback tag runtime:v2.3.9-stable for quick revert.

ops_bot: Suggested deploy job metadata:
```
job: windridge-dedicated-upgrade
image: redwood/runtime:v2.4.0-hotfix2
canary_steps: [5%:20m,25%:15m]
post_checks: smoke-short.txt, smoke-long.txt
rollback_action: pin-to:v2.3.9-stable
```

sylvia: QA will run the two post-check prompts after each step. I'll attach the smoke files to the job.

marta: Legal wants a one-line customer blurb for the notification. Draft: "Planned Windridge dedicated upgrade for stability fixes; brief canary-related latency changes possible; no model/data changes." Approve?

legal: Approved. Add contact: legal@redwood.com for questions. Keep it customer-facing.

kevin: Pushing image now — tagging runtime:v2.4.0-hotfix2, pushing manifest. CI in progress.

ops_bot: CI passed. deploybot can schedule when you confirm.

marta: One more ask: disable cross-region failover during the canary to avoid noise. We'll do manual failover only. Ops ack?

kevin: Ack. Manual only.

ops_bot: Ops acked. Runbook snippet saved at /runbooks/windridge-upgrade.md. Oncall: kevin.

marta: Please post the exact deploybot job so I can lock quiet window.

deploybot: @channel deploybot created job:
```
id: 4478889999-windridge-upgrade
start: 4478964600 (Sat 23:30 UTC)
image: redwood/runtime:v2.4.0-hotfix2
canary: 5% for 20m -> 25% for 15m -> 100%
post-checks: smoke-short.txt, smoke-long.txt
rollback: pin runtime:v2.3.9-stable
link: https://deploys.redwood.internal/jobs/4478889999
```

sylvia: QA attached smoke-short.txt and smoke-long.txt. We'll watch fidelity and embed throughput.

marta: Locking quiet window. If no objections by 18:00 UTC today I'll mark approved and trigger schedule. :lock: :shipit:

kevin: Approved.

legal: Approved.

ops_bot: Schedule confirmed. Reminder: metric alerts will auto-mute for canary window; manual rollback still required if gates breach.

marta: Thanks team — publishing customer note and ops runbook now.
